notices.format: No prescribed wording or type size; the contract needs a notice that all home improvement contractors must be licensed by the board and that inquiries go to the board's office
notices.support: the statute prescribes NO fixed wording. It says the contract shall "Contain a notice that all home improvement contractors must be licensed by the board and that any inquiries about a contractor should be transmitted to the board's office;"
notices.hold_reason: no prescribed wording; the statute only lists required content

notices.format: On the front side of the receipt or contract, or immediately above the buyer's signature, under the conspicuous caption, readily legible
notices.support: Caption "BUYER'S RIGHT TO CANCEL" must be "conspicuous" and the statement "readily legible", placed "on the front side of the receipt or contract, or immediately above the buyer's signature".

notices.title: Lien NOTICE TO OWNER before residential work
notices.trigger: Contractor about to contract to improve owner-occupied residential real property (one to four units); delivered before the work or the contract
notices.format: Written notice in substantially the statute's form, delivered by registered mail or otherwise
notices.support: 66-11-203 requires a contractor about to contract to improve residential real property to deliver a written notice to the owner "prior to commencing the improvement ... or making of the contract"

changes.new: One third of the contract price at or before signing, unless a bond is furnished or the owner agrees a payment schedule after written notice of the right to withhold final payment; no payment before the contract is signed (62-6-510(11), (12))
changes.support: no deposit over one third of the contract price at or before signing unless a bond is furnished
